niche_preference_profile: Prefers interfaces that make the next action obvious through strong hierarchy, visible buttons, and focused modal/card layouts. Tends to like polished, modern screens with soft depth, rounded cards, and cleaner visual organization. Often favors information-rich, fully designed screens that expose useful controls and context up front, but wants that information structured for fast scanning with clear labels, grouped sections, and reduced clutter. Also repeatedly prefers centered overlays or isolated task states that mute the background and keep attention on one decision or object.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers strong, obvious hierarchy with clear emphasis on the main item, title, key metadata, and actions; content should be easy to scan through spacing, sectioning, and structured grouping.
Prefers interfaces where primary and secondary actions are immediately visible, clearly labeled, and styled as obvious buttons rather than hidden, icon-only, or low-emphasis text actions.
Prefers centered, focused modals or isolated task states that foreground one object or decision, with the background subdued so surrounding content does not compete for attention.
Prefers screens that show complete, useful context and controls up front—metadata, status, options, and supporting details—rather than sparse or placeholder-like presentations.
Prefers simpler, cleaner organization with restrained clutter: lighter card weight, fewer competing elements, clearer grouping, and less icon or text noise.
Prefers polished, contemporary surfaces with layered cards, soft shadows, rounded containers, and cohesive component styling rather than flat or mixed-style layouts.
Prefers balanced, centered compositions with even distribution of elements across the screen, avoiding top-heavy, bottom-heavy, cramped, or awkwardly fragmented layouts.
